decisive_items: an amelanotic, pedunculated mass with an ulcerated surface, arising from the caruncle
Revealed a solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface, composed of large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Showed positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
response.rationale: C1 is the append-only completion of R4, preserving the full melanoma diagnosis and adding the raw-supported amelanotic subtype. R4 is the same clinical and histopathologic entity without that subtype qualifier, so C1 is more complete with no conflicting anatomy, time, polarity, or cause.
